## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION signaling receding near-term fear, and HYG/LQD mixed with HYG ↑ rising (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND and LQD ↑ rising (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.02%) RECOVERY — breadth strong but indicators neutral, supporting NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit steady: HYG ↑ rising (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND and LQD ↑ rising (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.02%) RECOVERY. Volatility dislocated: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION, creating a one-week calm inside a one-month volatile backdrop.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -2.02%) RECOVERY both ↑ rising, leaving SPY/TLT split essentially neutral; dollar and yield proxies show no clear pressure (data neutral).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Breadth-driven up week: Financials (XLF proxy) RECOVERY — Financials (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY; Technology (XLK) RECOVERY — XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY; Energy alone lagging in CORRECTION — XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given broad sector gains but 1M weakness.

**5. US vs Global?**
US showing a sharper one-week bounce: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY outpacing EMs: EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -0.90%) RECOVERY and China: FXI (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY — global catch-up but still mixed over 1M.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Spec flows rebounding short-term: ARKK (1W: +6.45% | 1M: -7.01%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +5.67% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY show renewed risk-on nibbling, while small caps IWM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY is participating.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil-led strength: USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals mixed with CPER (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY. Precious metals showing short-term bounce but 1M weakness: GLD (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -8.26%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +4.18% | 1M: -11.01%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Divergent: Oil ETFs ABOVE TREND (USO, BNO) while energy sector XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION shows stock-level profit-taking; natural gas UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Breadth strong (10/11) and multiple sectors positive this week. DIVERGENCE: Major divergence across core ETFs — SPY (1W +3.92% | 1M -3.02%) RECOVERY, XLK (1W +5.28% | 1M -2.30%) RECOVERY, XLF proxy (1W +5.22% | 1M -0.76%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W +1.58% | 1M -2.02%) RECOVERY — 1W vs 1M mismatches constitute a MAJOR DIVERGENCE, suppressing a strong regime call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor sectors showing sustained one-week strength and above-trend momentum: XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND and financial/tech participation (XLK RECOVERY, XLF RECOVERY); reduce exposure to energy equities XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION and monitor commodity volatility.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Biotech XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND; Financials XLF proxy (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION — watch if sector breadth turns negative.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND; monitor GLD/SLV for continuation of the one-week bounce vs 1M weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (vol complacency threshold) — current VXX ↓ falling (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION. HYG/LQD spread tightening (HYG ↑ rising (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD ↑ rising (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.02%) RECOVERY). XLK/XLF ratio pivot to watch for style rotation given RECOVERY status for both.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND and Financials/Tech showing strength while energy (XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION) lags. Key risk is the MAJOR 1W vs 1M divergence across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT) — monitor for reversal or dispersion widening.
